req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /tasks endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that all /tasks endpoints should return a JSON content type. This is crucial for ensuring that clients can correctly parse the response. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to handle client errors, and a boundary test to check the response when no tasks are available.

tests.name: test_get_tasks_returns_json_content_type
actions: Send a GET request to the /tasks endpoint.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/json'

tests.name: test_get_task_with_invalid_id_returns_404
actions: Send a GET request to the /tasks/999 endpoint where 999 is an invalid task ID.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/999')
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/json'

tests.name: test_get_tasks_with_limit_boundary
actions: Send a GET request to the /tasks endpoint with limit=1000.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/?limit=1000')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.headers['Content-Type'] == 'application/json'
